up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1123892. For each molecule, return the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from the molecule dictionary), its compound name (use the preferred name from the molecule dictionary), and its canonical SMILES (from the compound structures). Only include molecules that have a non-null canonical SMILES. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by compound name, then by canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123892'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
